title: A projective bundle is separated over its base
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal E$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-module of finite type [pqf-def-coherent], and let $\pi:\mathbf P_S(\mathcal E)=\operatorname{Proj}_S(\operatorname{Sym}_{\mathcal O_S}\mathcal E)\to S$ be the associated projective-bundle morphism [def-trf-projective-bundle-morphism]. Then $\pi$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism].

mathlib_searches.query: the structure morphism of a projective bundle over a scheme is separated
mathlib_searches.results: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.isSeparated and AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.instIsSeparated for affine Proj; no theorem for the relative projective bundle over an arbitrary scheme.
AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.isSeparated and IsSeparated.of_isAffineHom; no relative projective-bundle theorem.

from.place: The fibrewise ampleness-to-projectivity argument: the projective-bundle ambient morphism is separated before properness is used to turn the immersion into a closed immersion.
